Available now is this beautifully presented Type 3M villa in the heart of Springs 3, offering serene lake views, upgraded interiors, and a spacious private garden, perfect for family living.

• Type 3M (middle unit)
• Plot 3,128 sq ft
• 3 Bedrooms
• 3 Bathrooms
• Vacant Now
• Upgraded flooring
• Storage room
• Laundry room
• Built-in wardrobes
• Beautiful private garden
• Parking for 2 cars
• Gated community

Springs 3 is a sub-community in one of the most prestigious developments in Dubai, The Springs. Properties in the neighbourhood comprise villas tucked away from the city’s hustle. The community features lush green landscapes and idyllic houses with beautiful lake views and offers a tranquil lifestyle.
